rainier.text: WILDFIRE CLOSURES: Sunrise & northern trails. White River open.. Due to several active fires on the north side of the park, the following closures are in effect until further notice: Grand Park area & trails, Northern Loop Trail, Wonderland Trail from Carbon River Suspension Bridge to Frozen Lake, & associated backcountry campgrounds. White River Road & WR Campground reopened along with White River/Sunrise Trails. Sunrise Rd CLOSED to vehicles; open for pedestrians/bicycling only.

Your GPS May Be Wrong. There are five entrances to the park. GPS may take you to the wrong entrance or attempt to follow the most direct route, which could lead to closed gates. It can take hours to reroute to the correct entrance. Check directions & maps, not just your GPS.

Fryingpan Creek Bridge Replacement Project: Traffic and Trail Impacts. Parking is closed at the Summerland Trailhead on either side of Fryingpan Creek Bridge due to construction through 2029. Access to Summerland remains open via the Wonderland Trail with limited parking at White River Campground. Expect traffic delays of up to 30 minutes due to one-lane traffic on White River Road while it remains open for the season.

SR 165 Carbon River/Fairfax Bridge is closed: no access to Carbon River or Mowich Lake.. There is NO public access to Carbon River & Mowich Lake from SR 165.  The bridge is closed to pedestrians, bicycles and vehicles and there is no alternate route.

Ohanapecosh Campground area closed for construction in 2026. . The entire Ohanapecosh Campground area is CLOSED for the duration of the construction project, including all campsites, visitor center, restrooms, picnic area, & Ohanapecosh river access.

paradise.text: Overnight closure of SR 706 on October 16; no access to Nisqually Entrance.. SR706 outside of the park will be fully CLOSED overnight from 9 pm Friday 10/16 until 6 am Saturday 10/17, for road repairs to replace a failing culvert. The closure will be from Kernahan Road East to the Nisqually Entrance. There will be NO ACCESS to the Nisqually Entrance during the closure. To reach Paradise during the closure plan to enter the park through the Stevens Canyon Entrance via SR123 on the east side of the park.

paradise_gate.status: OPEN NOTE: The gate at Longmire may close for public safety at any time depending on weather/road conditions. Check Alerts for current status. Learn more about winter travel . Restrooms closed at Narada Falls. Restrooms available at Longmire or Paradise.
